head: 7062e4aa00592b17d4cd4b7743a8d71fe4b52c26
claim: The OpenClaw kit example sources and the openclaw change area are gone: the repository builds, type-checks and passes release lint without the example code or the openclaw change area

steps.start: main at the parent of this commit, with examples/openclaw-kit and the openclaw CI jobs present
steps: remove the openclaw-engine and openclaw-browser jobs, the openclaw change area and the example's browser step from CI
run build, tsc check, readme-check, release lint and the release test
steps.result: everything exits 0 and no file named in the summary mentions OpenClaw

verdicts.seen: Read one text capture (summary.txt). It states: "files left under examples/openclaw-kit: examples/openclaw-kit/web/favicon.svg examples/openclaw-kit/web/index.html" (the two UI files the slice intentionally keeps), "OpenClaw mentions left in .github/workflows/ci.yml, scripts/ci-changes.ts, tsconfig.json: 0 files", "ci-changes areas now: write, endpoint, record, seal, secrets, android, expo" (no openclaw area), and "build, tsc check, readme-check, release lint and scripts/release.test.ts all exited 0". This matches the outcome: example sources and the openclaw change area gone, with build, type-check and release lint passing. Nothing contradicts it.
